anes96.source: American National Election Studies 1996 (statsmodels public-domain copy)
anes96.limitations: Two questionnaire domains; same survey instrument, NOT independent sensor/modalities.

modechoice.source: Australian 1987 intercity travel mode-choice survey/network measurements (statsmodels public-domain copy)
modechoice.limitations: Naturally collected heterogeneous survey/network variables; NOT canonical multimodal image/text dataset.

independent_acquisition: not proven; ANES questionnaire domains; Modechoice survey and network variables

locked_protocol.freeze_timestamp_utc: 2026-11-10; recorded before inspecting any new test metric
locked_protocol.modalities_status: naturally recorded heterogeneous measurement groups, not independently acquired image/text/sensor modalities
locked_protocol.other_diagnostics: mean paired ARI vs PCA16, denoising contribution, gated vs shuffled, NMI, runtime
locked_protocol.train_val_test: stratified 60/20/20 for each seed; train scalers and clusters on training only
locked_protocol.corruption: matched train Gaussian/dropout; test coordinate permutation and additive offset pulses held out from fit
locked_protocol.missingness: independent view drop p=.2, resample all-missing; identical draws across methods
locked_protocol.parameters: fixed by previous implementation; no test-label tuning or refitting

scientific_limitations: Different observational domains, no independent sensor modalities; overlapping reseeded folds are NOT independent datasets.
